title: Egg-Stravaganza Ticket Sale!
text: Celebrate Easter and the start of spring with a full day of adventure at Woodlands! As the park reopens for the main season , all your favourite attractions are back in action after the winter break.

Enjoy the park as it comes to life in the spring sunshine , surrounded by beautiful countryside and plenty of adorable animals . Meet friendly creatures of all kinds around the park and experience the magic of nature in springtime.
 Book Your Eggstreme Easter!

With the park now fully open for the season , you can enjoy a full day packed with excitement. Take on our thrilling rides, feel the rush on our Water Coasters , and race down the Toboggan Run , now back open for the new season. When the sun is shining, there’s no better place...

Don’t miss our magical bird shows , where incredible birds take to the skies in a fascinating and entertaining display the whole family will love, and catch special appearances from Titan on 7th April and a well-loved TV character on 12th April!

title: Titan The Robot! 26th May
text: Blending comedy, street theatre, music and incredible special effects, Titan delivers a one-of-a-kind interactive show that has wowed audiences around the world. He’s appeared on hit TV shows including Big Brother, Daybreak and The Gadget Show, and starred at prestigious events...

Catch Titan in action at intervals throughout the day and enjoy a full day of family adventure at Woodlands — featuring thrilling rides, exciting attractions, indoor soft play, and our popular zoo farm. Don’t miss this spectacular robotic experience!
Appearances will be at intervals throughout the day.
For any enquiries, please email fun@woodlandspark.com or message us on social media.
Get ready for an unforgettable day of futuristic fun as Titan the Robot arrives at Woodlands Family Theme Park on Tuesday, 26th May!
Titan shows are included with standard admission tickets.
